On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. blocks.text: Listings of houses in Suncrest fell from 4 in June to 3 in October (−25.0%), and 6 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 0.7% of Burnaby’s 430 houses listed.

items.t: Upper Deer Lake houses for sale

Rumble Street is the spine: TransLink's 146 Metrotown Station and Suncrest loop turns through the area on Rumble Street between Joffre Avenue and Patterson Avenue, which is the clearest official trace of the neighbourhood's extent.

Burnaby South Secondary, the area's secondary school, stands at 5455 Rumble Street at the neighbourhood's northeast corner, and Clinton Elementary stands at 5858 Clinton Street on the area's south side.
The stock is all detached houses, which is what sets Suncrest apart from the tower stock of Metrotown immediately to the north and from the mixed stock of the Royal Oak station area to the east.

Detached lots here fall under the City's R1 small-scale multi-unit housing (SSMUH) district, so a house lot can be redeveloped as up to 3 to 6 dwelling units depending on lot area and proximity to a frequent transit network bus stop.

blocks.text: Suncrest Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Burnaby's new Zoning Bylaw 2026 was adopted June 9, 2026 and took effect July 1, 2026, replacing the former Zoning Bylaw 1965, and the R1 SSMUH district dates to the June 2024 rezoning of all R district lots.
Burnaby 2050, the City's official community plan, was adopted December 9, 2025 and sets the land-use direction for the whole city including this pocket.
Burnaby is inside the speculation and vacancy tax taxable area, so residential owners here must declare each year.

blocks.text: Suncrest Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Lewarne Park, on Macpherson Avenue at Rumble Street, sits on the eastern seam with South Slope in the Royal Oak community, so the pocket's park investment is shared with its eastern neighbour.
The 146 bus loop's turn on Rumble Street between Joffre Avenue and Patterson Avenue traces the pocket more precisely than any neighbourhood map the City publishes for Suncrest.
Burnaby South Secondary at 5455 Rumble Street anchors the northeast corner, so the school, not a shopping street, is the pocket's northeast landmark.

blocks.text: Suncrest Houses: development and new projects

items.t: Lewarne Park playground, Macpherson Avenue at Rumble Street, City of Burnaby: new playground with play tower, spinner, swings, in-ground trampoline, tot play area and sports court improvements on the park's east side — STATUS: design underway, construction over summer 2026, opening fall 2026; read 2026-11-03.

Burnaby's 2026 residential tax rate is 3.28373 per 1,000 dollars of assessed value, and the average residential assessment in Burnaby decreased by 5.29 percent in 2026, which does not necessarily mean an individual bill falls, because taxes depend on the change in a property's assessment relative to the class average.
Property taxes were due July 3, 2026, with a 5 percent penalty after the July due date and a further 5 percent after the September due date.
Assessment notices arrive from BC Assessment each January, and the assessed value on the notice is the value the mill rate is applied to.
The 146 Metrotown Station and Suncrest loop runs on Rumble Street between Joffre Avenue and Patterson Avenue, tying the pocket to Metrotown Station to the north.
Marine Drive is the slope's bottom street to the south, and Rumble Street is the top street of the South Slope hill frame that Suncrest shares.

items.t: Confirm the lot's R1 SSMUH eligibility and unit count with the City before assuming a multiplex, because the count turns on lot area and on distance to a frequent transit network bus stop.
Confirm whether a lot on the Rumble Street edge falls in the Royal Oak Community Plan's station-area rules rather than the standard R1 rules.

11 houses sold in Suncrest with a median price of $1,550,000 (the middle half sold between $1,415,000 and $1,590,000), taking a median of 38 days to sell at 95.8% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Suncrest?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 3 houses listed in Suncrest. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Suncrest a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Suncrest had a sales ratio of 33% on only 3 listed, too few to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Suncrest from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 6 houses sold in Suncrest over those 5 months, out of 251 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Suncrest?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.
Clinton Elementary, at 5858 Clinton Street, is the School District No.

faq.q: Can I build a multiplex on a Suncrest house lot?
faq.a: Possibly, under the R1 SSMUH district: newly rezoned R1 lots are eligible for up to 3 to 6 dwelling units depending on lot area and proximity to a frequent transit network bus stop, and the count is inclusive of any secondary suites.
No. Suncrest is the all-detached pocket below Metrotown, and Metrotown's tower stock sits to the north; the pocket's own spine is Rumble Street, not the town-centre streets.

faq.q: What is the 2026 residential tax rate?
faq.a: Burnaby's 2026 residential mill rate totals 3.28373 per 1,000 dollars of assessed value, and gross taxes are the assessed value multiplied by the mill rate and divided by 1,000, before local area service, sewer parcel and business improvement area charges.

faq.q: What did houses in Suncrest sell for?
faq.a: 11 houses sold in Suncrest between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,550,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Suncrest?
faq.a: The median was 38 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 95.8% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
